system: KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) - a separate system, not part of the Parashari knowledge base
description: KP house groups: the sub lord of the main cusp of a matter must signify the matter's houses for the matter to be promised. Houses that are the 12th from those houses work against it.

rules.promise: The sub lord of the matter's main cusp is judged by the houses its star lord signifies (occupies and owns); its own houses are a second, weaker level.
rules.against: The 12th house from any house negates it, so the houses 12th from each favourable house (minus the favourable ones) are read as obstructing.
rules.nodes: Rahu and Ketu act as agents of their sign lord, so they also give the houses of that lord.
rules.retrograde: A cusp sub lord that is retrograde, or in the star of a retrograde planet, is read as delay or obstruction until it turns direct.
rules.timing: Events come in the periods of planets that signify the matter's houses.

sources: K. S. Krishnamurti, Krishnamurti Paddhati Readers (house grouping and sub lord theory)

KP house combinations (education 4-9-11, foreign travel 3-9-12, building 4-11-12, speculation 2-5-6-11, independent business 2-7-10) as given in widely used KP study notes

cusps.1: Yourself: body, energy, personality and the way you meet life.
cusps.2: Money you earn and keep, family, speech and food.
cusps.3: Courage, writing and communication, short journeys, neighbours and younger siblings.
cusps.4: Home, mother, property, vehicles, inner peace and basic education.
cusps.5: Romance, creativity, intelligence, speculation and past good deeds.
cusps.6: Work and service, competition, loans and debts, illness and recovery.
cusps.7: Marriage, partners in life and business, contracts and the public.
cusps.8: Inheritance, insurance, shared money, hidden matters and sudden changes.
cusps.9: Luck, father and teachers, higher learning, faith and long journeys.
cusps.10: Career, status, authority and your public reputation.
cusps.11: Gains, income, friends, elder siblings and wishes coming true.
cusps.12: Expenses, investment, foreign lands, rest, retreat and letting go.

matters.title: Good health and general wellbeing

matters.against_note: KP reads 6, 8 and 12 as the houses of illness, so they work against health instead of the plain 12th-from rule.
